That depends on what you want out of the day, so here's the short version. For most people, a good leg day has a squat or leg press pattern, a hip hinge like an RDL, something single-leg like split squats or lunges, and a little calf and hamstring work to round it out. Around 3 to 4 sets of 6 to 12 reps on each, with a weight that leaves 2 to 3 reps in the tank, is a solid place to start.

If you want me to set one up, tell me to give you a leg day and I'll have the app build it. If you've got a time limit or you're at a different gym today, say so and I'll build around it.
